# App no longer focused (`app_unfocused`)

**Kind:** trigger · **Category:** Apps · **Available in:** personal automations

Fires when the app stops being the active window, because another app was focused or the app was closed or minimized.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `app` | app or list of apps | yes |  | The app(s) that lose focus. Use the exe name (chrome or chrome.exe), a full path (C:\Games\game.exe) or wildcards (*steam*). Use * for any app. |
| `title` | text or list of text | no |  | Only fire when the title of the window that lost focus matches one of these patterns. |

## Example

```yaml
triggers:
  - type: app_unfocused
    app: POWERPNT.EXE
```

## Notes

Only available in personal automations. Tip: instead of writing a separate 'unfocused' automation to undo changes, apply a profile on `app_focused`; it is reverted automatically when the app loses focus.
